Shotgun: damage and piercing, same encounter

Play current game · Technical report · Native audit · Matching revision

These are controlled comparisons on the same map, not three map choices. Each run starts from an identical loaded crowd and fires six shells:48 pellets. Only the shotgun impact profile changes. The last column is the playable setting.

ProfileBullet contactsZombie deathsMax targets / pelletShells spent

Native diagnostic images use10000HP to survive the full crowd observation; shipped gameplay remains100HP. The initial crowd is128 alive/109 visible. Pending waves refill killed slots, so global alive stays128; kills are not a net population reduction. Heavy blood/crowd occlusion remains an existing readability issue. This automated run does not accept human balance, animation quality or the full Sprint.

Every pellet has its own limit and75% damage retention:20,15,11. Walls, closed gates and live props still stop it. Ammo, spread, range, reload, muzzle/audio/casing and the authored art pipeline are retained.
